spans.s:
अर्ध 1. अर्ध, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. ऋध्),
Ved. side, part; place, region, country [cf. Lat. ordo,
Germ. ort]. The accent is on the first syllable.

2. अर्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, half, halved, forming a half
[cf. Osset. ardag]; अर्ध अर्ध, one part, the other
part; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the half; one part of two, a
part, a party; half; a short syllable. The accent is
on the last syllable. (अर्ध may be compounded in
a peculiar way with an ordinal, e. g. अर्ध-तृतीय,
containing (two and) the third (only) half, i. e. two
and a half; अर्ध-चतुर्थ, three and a half, &c.)
—अर्ध-काल or अर्ध-कूट, अस्, m. an epithet
of Śiva.
—अर्ध-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, half-done, half-
performed.
—अर्ध-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a Rudra.
—अर्ध-कोटी, f. half a crore, five millions.
—अर्-
ध-कोष, अस्, m. a moiety of one's treasure.
—अर्ध-क्रोश, अस्, m. half a league.
—अर्ध-
खार, अम्, ई, n. f. a measure, half a khārī.
—अर्ध-
गङ्गा, f., N. of the river Kāverī.
—अर्ध-गर्भ,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in the middle of the womb.
—अर्-
ध-गुच्छ, अस्, m. a necklace of twenty-four
strings.
—अर्ध-गोल, अस्, m. a hemisphere.
—अर्-
ध-चक्रवर्तिन् or अर्ध-चक्रिन्, ई, m. half a
cakravartin; N. of the nine black Vāsudevas and the
nine enemies of Viṣṇu.
—अर्ध-चन्द्र, अस्, m.
half-moon; the semicircular marks on a peacock's
tail; the semicircular scratch of the finger nail; an
arrow, the head of which is like a half-moon; the
hand bent into a semicircle or the shape of a claw, as
for the purpose of seizing or clutching anything; (आ),
f., N. of the plant Convolvulus Torpethum; (अस्, आ,
अम्), crescent-shaped, of a semilunar form.
—अर्ध-
चन्द्राकार (˚र-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, or अर्ध-
चन्द्राकृति, इस्, इस्, इ, half-moon-shaped, crescent-
shaped; (अस्), m. or (इस्), f. a meniscus.
—अर्ध-
चन्द्रिका, f., N. of a climbing plant.
—अर्ध-
चोलक, अस्, m. a short bodice.
—अर्ध-जाह्नवी, f.,
N. of the river Kāverī.
—अर्ध-तनु, उस्, f. half a
body.
—अर्ध-तिक्त, अस्, m., N. of a plant.
—अर्-
ध-तूर, अस्, m. a particular kind of musical instru-
ment.
—अर्ध-दग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, half-burnt.
—अर्ध-दिवस, अस्, m. half a day, midday; a
day containing one half of a whole day, a day of
twelve hours.
—अर्ध-देव, अस्, m., Ved. demi-god.
—अर्ध-धार, अम्, n. a knife or lancet with a
single edge, the blade two inches long, the handle six.
—अर्ध-नारायण, अस्, m. a form of Viṣṇu.
—अर्ध-नारीश (˚री-ईश), अस्, m. one of the forms
of Śiva (half male and half female).
—अर्ध-नाव,
अम्, n. half a boat.
—अर्ध-निशा, f. midnight.
—अर्-
ध-पञ्चाशत्, f. twenty-five.
—अर्ध-पण, अम्,
n. a measure containing half a paṇa.
—अर्ध-पथ,
अम्, n. half-way; (ए), ind. midway.
—अर्ध-पादिक,
अस्, आ, अम्, having only half a foot.
—अर्ध-पारा-
वत, अस्, m. a kind of pigeon.
—अर्ध-पुलायित, अम्,
n. a half-gallop, canter.
—अर्ध-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्,
half-full.
—अर्ध-प्रहर, अस्, m. half a watch, one
hour and a half.
—अर्ध-बृहती, f., Ved. half the
usual breadth.
—अर्ध-भाग, अस्, m. a half; a
part.
—अर्ध-भागिक, अस्, ई, अम्, or अर्ध-भा-
गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking or sharing half.
—अर्ध-भाज्,
क्, क्, क्, taking or sharing half; (क्), m. a sharer,
companion.
—अर्ध-भास्कर, अस्, m. midday.
—अर्ध-भोटिक, f. a kind of cake.
—अर्ध-मा-
गधी, f. a variety of the Māgadhī dialect.
—अर्ध-
माणव or अर्ध-माणवक, अस्, m. a necklace of
twelve strings.
—अर्ध-मात्रा, f. half a short sylla-
[]
ble.
—अर्ध-मार्गे, ind. half-way, midway.
—अर्-
ध-मास, अस्, m. half a month; अर्धमास-शस्,
ind. every half month, or fortnight.
—अर्धमास-
तम, अस्, आ, अम्, or अर्धमासिक, अस्, आ, अम्,
done or happening every half month; lasting half
a month, or a fortnight.
—अर्ध-मुष्टि, इस्, m. f.
a half-clenched hand.
—अर्ध-याम, अस्, m. half a
watch, an hour and a half.
—अर्ध-रथ, अस्, m.
a warrior who fights on a car along with another.
—अर्ध-रात्र, अस्, m. midnight; a night contain-
ing half a whole day of twenty-four hours.
—अर्ध-
रात्र-समय, अस्, m. the time of midnight.
—अर्-
धरात्रार्धदिवस (˚रात्र-अर्ध˚), अम्, n. the
equinox.
—अर्धर्च (˚ध-ऋच), अस्, अम्, m. n.
half a verse or hemistich.
—अर्धर्च-शस्, ind. in
every hemistich.
—अर्ध-वस्त्र-संवीत, अस्, आ,
अम्, clothed or enveloped in half-garments.
—अर्ध-
विसर्ग, अस्, m. the sound Visarga before क्, ख्, प्,
फ्, so called because its sign (Z) is the half of that
of Visarga (ः).
—अर्ध-वीक्षण, अम्, n. a side-
look, a glance, a leer.
—अर्ध-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्,
middle-aged.
—अर्ध-वैनाशिक, अस्, m., N. of the
followers of Kaṇāda (‘arguing half-perishableness’).
—अर्ध-व्यास, अस्, m. the radius of a circle.
—अर्ध-शत, अम्, n. fifty; one hundred and
fifty.
—अर्धशन, अम्, for अर्धाशन (˚ध-
अश्˚), अम्, n. half a meal.
—अर्ध-शफर, अस्,
m. a kind of fish.
—अर्ध-शब्द, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing a low voice.
—अर्ध-शेष or अर्धावशेष
(˚ध-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having only half left.
—अर्-
धाश्याम, अस्, आ, अम्, half-clouded.
—अर्ध-
श्लोक, अस्, m. half a Śloka.
—अर्ध-सञ्जात-शस्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, having its crops half-grown.
—अर्ध-
सीरिन्, ई, m. a cultivator, a ploughman, who takes
half the crop for his labour.
—अर्ध-हार, अस्,
m. a necklace of sixty-four or of forty strings.
—अर्-
ध-ह्रस्व, अम्, n. half a short syllable.
—अर्-
धांश (˚ध-अं˚), अस्, m. a half, the half.
—अर्-
धांशिन् (˚ध-अं˚),ई, इनी, इ, sharing a half.
—अर्धा-
कार (˚ध-अ˚), अस्, m. half the letter अ; another
name for अवग्रह, q. v.
—अर्धाङ्ग (˚ध-अङ्˚),
अम्, n. half the body.
—अर्धार्ध (˚ध-अर्˚),
अस्, m. half of a half, a quarter; half and half.
—अर्-
धावभेदक (˚ध-अव्˚), अस्, m. pain in half the
head, hemicrania; (अम्), n. dividing in equal parts.
—अर्धावशेष (˚ध-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
only one half left.
—अर्धाशन (˚ध-अश्˚), अम्,
n. half a meal.
—अर्धासन (˚ध-आस्˚), अम्, n.
half a seat (it is considered a mark of high respect to
make room for a guest on the same seat with one's
self); greeting kindly or with respect; exemption
from censure.
—अर्धेन्दु (˚ध-इन्˚), उस्, m. a half-
moon or crescent; the semicircular impression of a
finger nail; an arrow with a crescent-shaped head;
the hand expanded in a semicircular from like a claw.
—अर्धेन्दु-मौलि (˚ध-इन्˚), इस्, m. Śiva, whose
diadem is a half-moon.
—अर्धेन्द्र (˚ध-इन्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, that of which a half belongs to Indra.
—अर्धोक्त (˚ध-उक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, half-uttered, said
imperfectly or indistinctly.
—अर्धोक्ति (˚ध-उक्˚),
इस्, f. speaking indistinctly or incompletely, broken
or interrupted speech.
—अर्धोदय (˚ध-उद्˚),
अस्, m. the rising of the half-moon.
—अर्धोदित
(˚ध-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम् (rt. इ with उद्), half-risen;
(rt. वद्), half-uttered.
—अर्धोरुक (˚ध-ऊरु),
अस्, आ, अम्, reaching to the middle of the thighs;
(अम्), n. a short petticoat.

आर्ध आर्ध (fr. अर्ध), used at the begin-
ning of compounds to express ‘half.’

अर्धक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the same as अर्ध.
—अर्धक-घातिन्, ई, m., N. of Rudra.

अर्धङ्-कृ, cl. 8. P., Ved. -करोति, -कर्तुम्,
to prefer, to favour.

अर्धिक, अस्, ई, अम्, measuring a half, relating to
a half.
अर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, entitled to half or sharing a half.

अर्धुक अर्धुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ऋध्), Ved.
succeeding, prospering.

आर्धुक आर्धुक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. ऋध्), Ved.
conducive to success, useful, beneficial.

अर्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be accomplished; to be
obtained.

आर्ध् आर्ध् (आ-ऋध्), Desid. A. एर्त्सते, to
wish to obtain or to collect.

आर्धद्रौणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bought with half a
drona, containing it, &c.

आर्धधातुक, अस्, ई, अम्, applicable to half the
root or to the shorter form of the verbal base; this
is the name of those terminations and affixes which
belong to the six non-conjugational or general tenses.
These terminations are supposed to be affixed im-
mediately to the root or with the interposition only
of an augment, such as the inserted इ.

आर्धप्रस्थिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bought &c. with
half a prastha.

आर्धमासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, lasting &c. for half a
month; observing or practising (continence &c.) for
a fortnight.

आर्धरात्रिक, आस्, m. pl. (fr. अर्ध-रात्र), N.
of an astronomical school who reckoned the begin-
ning of the motions of the planets from midnight.
